note: Core/Webhooks/ ships on every emitted SDK, and the skills tell a reader that inbound signature verification is theirs to write. Three things have to stay true for that to be safe advice: the verifier stays unreachable, nothing generated starts calling it, and the parser keeps not verifying. All three are Core facts, so they are checked on the generator template too - which is the run that would catch the generator wiring verification up.

assertions.claim: SignatureVerifier is `internal sealed`, so no caller code can construct or subclass it.
No InternalsVisibleTo is emitted, so the internal verifier stays unreachable even from a friend assembly.
WebhookEventParser.Parse performs no signature verification - it parses JSON and delegates to CreateEvent.
SignatureVerifier is referenced nowhere but its own file - nothing generated calls it.
